name: JKGLAND
recent: JKG Land Berhad 近期出现董事权益变动，执行副主席 Dato' Ir Chuah Chin Ah JP 的配偶通过赠与方式获得 16,214,600 股普通股。公司最新季度（截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日）营收和净利同比大幅下滑。此外，公司近期新闻主要围绕其 Mont Kiara 的 AOSIS 项目进行宣传。
notable: 执行副主席 Dato' Ir Chuah Chin Ah JP 的配偶通过赠与方式获得 16,214,600 股普通股（视同权益）。
公司发布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度的业绩，营收和净利同比大幅下降。
risks: 最新季度净利同比大跌 96.8%，净利率从 11.8% 降至 1.3%。
营收同比减少 64.4%，环比减少 29.0%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度，营收为 MYR 18,046,000，同比下滑 64.4%，环比下滑 29.0%；净利为 MYR 231,000，同比下滑 96.8%，环比下滑 92.3%；净利率为 1.3%，低于上一季度的 11.8%。

recent_en: JKG Land Berhad recently saw a change in director's interest, with 16,214,600 ordinary shares acquired by the spouse of Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Ir Chuah Chin Ah JP via a gift. The company's latest quarter (ended 31 July 2026) saw significant year-on-year declines in revenue and net profit. Meanwhile, recent news coverage focused on promoting its AOSIS project in Mont Kiara.
notable_en: The spouse of Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Ir Chuah Chin Ah JP acquired 16,214,600 ordinary shares via a gift (deemed interest).
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue and net profit declining significantly year-on-year.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit plunged 96.8% year-on-year, with net margin dropping from 11.8% to 1.3%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 18,046,000, down 64.4% year-on-year and 29.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 231,000, down 96.8% year-on-year and 92.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 1.3%, lower than 11.8% in the previous quarter.
